coordinates.world: right-handed, z-up; scene geometry centered by subtracting structure.center

notes: Colors are linear sRGB values used directly (no gamma conversion in shaders).
hexWithAlpha = 0xAARRGGBB only where noted; u32 colors default to 0xRRGGBB.
All overlay layout sizes are 'design px' and must be multiplied by dpiScale (= devicePixelRatio).

polyhedron.faceColor: element color of the center atom

lighting.space: view space (lights rotate with the camera; directions are constants in view space)

radii.rule: BallAndStick/Polyhedral: transition metals use covalent radius, all other elements use vdW; SpaceFill: always vdW with fixed 0.92 scale (atomScale ignored).

ghost.note: reserved protocol: atom flags bit2 + separate blended pass; never filled in v1.1.0
